verdict.rationale: Event-driven rule automation is a fair question for a compliance platform, but the evidence has no product-native way for users to define event-triggered rules that run actions. Webhooks (vanta-docs-4) only emit event notifications, a developer building block for constructing automation externally. Vendor-fixed automations such as reminders, NDA approvals and Custom Tests are adjacent features, not user-defined trigger-action rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
